title: Psalm 75
opening_line: To thee, O God, do we give thanks,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: To thee, O God, do we give thanks,
text.normalized: To thee, O God, do we give thanks,
text.reading: To thee, O God, do we give thanks,

text.diplomatic: we do give thanks to thee;
text.normalized: We do give thanks to thee;
text.reading: we do give thanks to thee;

text.diplomatic: Because thy wondrous works declare
text.normalized: Because thy wondrous works declare
text.reading: Because thy wondrous works declare

text.diplomatic: thy great name near to be.
text.normalized: Thy great name near to be.
text.reading: thy great name near to be.

text.diplomatic: I purpose, when I shall receive
text.normalized: I purpose, when I shall receive
text.reading: I purpose, when I shall receive

text.diplomatic: the congregätion,
text.normalized: The congregätion,
text.reading: the congregätion,

text.diplomatic: That I shall judgment uprightly
text.normalized: That I shall judgment uprightly
text.reading: That I shall judgment uprightly

text.diplomatic: render to everyone.
text.normalized: Render to everyone.
text.reading: render to everyone.

text.diplomatic: Dissolvèd is the land, with all
text.normalized: Dissolvèd is the land, with all
text.reading: Dissolvèd is the land, with all

text.diplomatic: that in the same do dwell;
text.normalized: That in the same do dwell;
text.reading: that in the same do dwell;

text.diplomatic: But I the pillars thereof do
text.normalized: But I the pillars thereof do
text.reading: But I the pillars thereof do

text.diplomatic: bear up, and stablish well.
text.normalized: Bear up, and stablish well.
text.reading: bear up, and stablish well.

text.diplomatic: I to the foolish people said,
text.normalized: I to the foolish people said,
text.reading: I to the foolish people said,

text.diplomatic: Do not deal foolishly;
text.normalized: Do not deal foolishly;
text.reading: Do not deal foolishly;

text.diplomatic: And unto those that wicked are,
text.normalized: And unto those that wicked are,
text.reading: And unto those that wicked are,

text.diplomatic: Lift not your horn on high.
text.normalized: Lift not your horn on high.
text.reading: Lift not your horn on high.

text.diplomatic: Lift not your horn on high, nor speak
text.normalized: Lift not your horn on high, nor speak
text.reading: Lift not your horn on high, nor speak

text.diplomatic: with stubborn neck. But know,
text.normalized: With stubborn neck. But know,
text.reading: with stubborn neck. But know,

text.diplomatic: That not from east, nor west, nor south,
text.normalized: That not from east, nor west, nor south,
text.reading: That not from east, nor west, nor south,

text.diplomatic: promötion doth flow.
text.normalized: Promötion doth flow.
text.reading: promötion doth flow.

text.diplomatic: But God is judge; he puts down one,
text.normalized: But God is judge; he puts down one,
text.reading: But God is judge; he puts down one,

text.diplomatic: and sets another up.
text.normalized: And sets another up.
text.reading: and sets another up.

text.diplomatic: For in the hand of GOD most high
text.normalized: For in the hand of GOD most high
text.reading: For in the hand of GOD most high

text.diplomatic: of red wine is a cup:
text.normalized: Of red wine is a cup:
text.reading: of red wine is a cup:

text.diplomatic: ’Tis full of mixture, he pours forth,
text.normalized: ’Tis full of mixture, he pours forth,
text.reading: ’Tis full of mixture, he pours forth,

text.diplomatic: and makes the wicked all
text.normalized: And makes the wicked all
text.reading: and makes the wicked all

text.diplomatic: Wring out the bitter dregs thereof;
text.normalized: Wring out the bitter dregs thereof;
text.reading: Wring out the bitter dregs thereof;

text.diplomatic: yea, and they drink them shall.
text.normalized: Yea, and they drink them shall.
text.reading: yea, and they drink them shall.

text.diplomatic: But I for ever will declare,
text.normalized: But I for ever will declare,
text.reading: But I for ever will declare,

text.diplomatic: I Jacob’s God will praise.
text.normalized: I Jacob’s God will praise.
text.reading: I Jacob’s God will praise.

text.diplomatic: All horns of lewd men I’ll cut off;
text.normalized: All horns of lewd men I’ll cut off;
text.reading: All horns of lewd men I’ll cut off;

text.diplomatic: but just men’s horns will raise.
text.normalized: But just men’s horns will raise.
text.reading: but just men’s horns will raise.
